title: Command Palette
purpose: Modal interface for searching and executing commands from the menu hierarchy
states: open-list - palette open showing filtered command list
asking-arg - palette waiting for user to type argument
acceptance: shall open with empty search field
shall display all executable menu commands when closed
shall filter commands as user types
shall allow navigating with arrow keys
shall support commands that require an argument
shall close on Escape or backdrop click
shall reset to empty field on next open
